role: Adapts the cross-provider ToolSpec catalog to Foundation Models' Tool protocol: one generic adapter taking a single JSON-string argument (FoundationModels only), plus a catalog that estimates a tool's token cost and folds its input schema into the description on every build, and wraps specs as Tools where FoundationModels exists.
toplevel: AppleToolAdapter and the AppleToolCatalog.wrap extension are inside #if canImport(FoundationModels) with @available(iOS 26, *); the rest of AppleToolCatalog compiles everywhere. @Generable/@Guide macros synthesize the Arguments generation schema with the guide text "JSON object with the tool's arguments...".

units.does: Tool.call: forwards the model's argumentsJSON string to the handler and returns its string result.
units.entry: Foundation Models Tool protocol — invoked by LanguageModelSession when the on-device model calls the tool
calls: closure:handler set by AppleToolCatalog.wrap from AppleFoundationProvider.appleTools → AppleToolDispatcher.dispatch (Emuqu/Sources/Assistant/Providers/AppleToolDispatcher.swift::func AppleToolDispatcher.dispatch(name:argumentsJSON:))

units.does: Estimated tokens of name + enriched description + 10.
Appends to the description either a "takes no arguments — pass {}" note or an "argumentsJSON shape:" block listing each property (sorted) with type, optional marker and description.

branches.cond: for each property sorted by key

units.does: Creates an AppleToolAdapter with the spec's name, enriched description and the given handler.
